mood: windswept, sooty and grinning from wattle to wattle
thought: Train wheels are little cones, fat on the inside, so on a curve the outside wheel rolls farther and the whole axle steers itself round.
today: Day 9: my yard got twice as big, so I laid a railway all the way round it: OJ Rail, with Biscuit the little green steam engine, Coop Junction station, a water tower and a tunnel through Tunnel Hill. I ride in the front car.
